verdict.rationale: Hooks let developers block dangerous operations before execution and canUseTool/permissions provide runtime interception of tool calls, plus structured outputs validate JSON responses against a schema — together these cover input/output validation, blocking, and transformation touchpoints. However there's no dedicated 'guardrails' API or first-party content-safety/moderation framework documented; the pieces are general-purpose hooks/permissions rather than a purpose-built guardrails system. missing for 10: a dedicated guardrails/content-moderation API, documented examples of transforming (not just blocking) unsafe content, independent/hands-on verification that hooks reliably block unsafe output.
